saw_lines: Shoppers choose a saree by fabric and drape, then buy again only when a wedding or festival comes around.
So the sale is won in the first line, where fabric and occasion get named before a shopper scrolls past.
Your site shows 45515 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: The site shows 45515 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to trust. Put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a review quote about the silk fabric.
12 of 23 copy ads open on the pick any 2 line, so one story carries the account. Build two or three fresh openers from your silk Banarasi and ready to wear lines, and test them against it.
One exact copy runs in 12 of 23 ads, so the same words repeat across the account. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each, and give every variation its own product photo.

7 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product they show, so the saree that caught their eye is one search away. Point each ad to its own product page, starting with the silk Banarasi line.

ads_1: Review count led saree creative with two fresh openers beside pick any 2
